conbody.p: The Vibration Z FFT (vibzFFT) is the vibration amplitude measured in the axial direction of the motor. The recorded data is the result of the FFT transformation of the vibration signal Z, in the unit of decibels (dB).

li.p: Each record contains an FFT of the vibz samples captured on the specified timestamp.
It is necessary to generate the corresponding X-axis data to plot this vibzFFT data in a graphic. The X-axis data is a vector of 7,500 data points with a step of 0.41667 Hertz (Hz).
For more information on API refer to the ADI OtoSense™ SMS REST API.
